title: Neural Monge Map estimation and its applications
tldr_zh: Monge 问题 Lagrange 松弛成 max-min，一般 cost、跨维度，duality gap 给后验误差界；unpaired 文生图与补全
tldr_en: Lagrangian max-min for the Monge problem with general costs and unequal dimensions, a duality-gap posterior error bound, applied to unpaired text-to-image and inpainting.
key_numbers: Unpaired inpainting CelebA64 FID: alpha=0 18.79, alpha=1000 4.76, alpha=10000 3.71 vs WGAN-GP 6.75 (Table 1)
Class-preserving map accuracy MNIST->KMNIST 99.59%, FMNIST->MNIST 99.73% vs Asadulaev et al. 79.20/82.97 (deterministic) (Table 2)
Class-preserving FID MNIST->KMNIST 18.07 vs 17.26/9.69, FMNIST->MNIST 5.78 vs 7.15/5.26 (Table 2)
Error bound ||T-T*||_{L2(beta rho_a)} <= sqrt(2(E1+E2)) under c-concave f and consistent saddle point (Theorem 4)
Text-to-image training 21h on RTX A6000; CelebA64/128 inpainting 10h/45h (Appendix F)
